purpose: Define DWH local and remote data paths as separate semantic scopes so remote access never silently expands local authority or local data ownership.

owns: DWH Local and Remote Separation semantics

topics.name: DWH Local vs Remote
topics.purpose: Define DWH local and remote data paths as separate semantic scopes so remote access never silently expands local authority or local data ownership.

semantics.local_rule: Local DWH data remains scoped to the owning local context/instance.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote DWH data is accessed through an explicit remote semantic path and remote authority boundary.
semantics.separation_rule: Local and remote data are independent dimensions; one does not inherit authority from the other.
semantics.ownership_rule: Local ownership does not imply remote ownership or write rights.
semantics.access_rule: Remote access requires explicit peer/remote target resolution.
semantics.projection_rule: A combined projection may show local and remote data together but preserves locality provenance.

invariants.rule: DWH local/remote, origin, schema, external identity, access path and transport-security semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: local rights silently expand to remote target
remote rights inferred from local ownership
remote data treated as local canonical storage
remote access path inferred from transport endpoint only

references.purpose: Remote DWH uses explicit governed remote dereference.

prose.summary: Define DWH local and remote data paths as separate semantic scopes so remote access never silently expands local authority or local data ownership.
